headline: 蜘蛛侠热度领跑 多部新作蓄势待发
headlineEn: Spider-Man Leads Buzz, New Titles Ready to Launch
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共3部新片。热门话题由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑，《特别行动：母狮》《飞出个未来》《奥德赛》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》紧随其后。接下来《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》即将上映。
summaryEn: No new movies hit theaters today, with only three new releases this week. Trending buzz is led by Spider-Man: Brand New Day, followed by Special Ops: Lioness, Futurama, The Odyssey, and House of the Dragon. Upcoming titles include The Last Sunrise, OK Boss's Wife 2, and Escape from Death Street.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共有3部新片与观众见面。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies today; three new titles arrive this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》登顶今日热度榜，表现强势。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops today's trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 多部剧集如《特别行动：母狮》《飞出个未来》持续占据话题榜。
industryHighlights.en: Series like Special Ops: Lioness and Futurama dominate discussions.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单公布：《最后的日出》《OK老板娘2》《逃出绝命街》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming slate revealed: The Last Sunrise, OK Boss's Wife 2, and Escape from Death Street.
